---- MODULE MultiShardTxnSnapshot ----
EXTENDS MultiShardTxnSnapshotDefs

\* BEGIN AGENT HELPERS
LOCAL AgT == INSTANCE TLAPS
LOCAL AgFS == INSTANCE FiniteSetTheorems
LOCAL AgFold == INSTANCE FoldsTheorems
LOCAL AgSeqT == INSTANCE SequenceTheorems

LEMMA AgBridgeFinite == \A S : AgFS!IsFiniteSet(S) <=> IsFiniteSet(S)
  BY DEF AgFS!IsFiniteSet, IsFiniteSet

LEMMA AgBridgeCard == \A S : AgFS!Cardinality(S) = Cardinality(S)
  BY DEF AgFS!Cardinality, Cardinality

(***************************************************************************)
(* Recursive unfolding of PermSeqs.                                        *)
(***************************************************************************)
AgPermsDef(g, ss) ==
  IF ss = {} THEN { << >> }
  ELSE UNION { { Append(sq,x) : sq \in g[ss \ {x}] } : x \in ss }

AgPerms(S) == CHOOSE perms : perms = [ss \in SUBSET S |-> AgPermsDef(perms, ss)]

LEMMA AgPermSeqsUnfold == \A S : PermSeqs(S) = AgPerms(S)[S]
  BY DEF PermSeqs, AgPerms, AgPermsDef

LEMMA AgSSOWellFounded ==
  ASSUME NEW S, IsFiniteSet(S)
  PROVE  AgFS!IsWellFoundedOn(AgFS!StrictSubsetOrdering(S), SUBSET S)
  <1>1. AgFS!FiniteSubsetsOf(S) = SUBSET S
    BY AgFS!FS_FiniteSubsetsOfFinite, AgBridgeFinite
  <1>2. AgFS!IsWellFoundedOn(AgFS!StrictSubsetOrdering(S), AgFS!FiniteSubsetsOf(S))
    BY AgFS!FS_StrictSubsetOrderingWellFounded
  <1> QED BY <1>1, <1>2

LEMMA AgPermsRec ==
  ASSUME NEW S, IsFiniteSet(S)
  PROVE  AgPerms(S) = [ss \in SUBSET S |-> AgPermsDef(AgPerms(S), ss)]
  <1> DEFINE R == AgFS!StrictSubsetOrdering(S)
  <1>1. AgFS!IsWellFoundedOn(R, SUBSET S)
    BY AgSSOWellFounded
  <1>2. AgFS!WFDefOn(R, SUBSET S, AgPermsDef)
    <2> SUFFICES ASSUME NEW g, NEW h, NEW ss \in SUBSET S,
                        \A y \in AgFS!SetLessThan(ss, R, SUBSET S) : g[y] = h[y]
                 PROVE  AgPermsDef(g, ss) = AgPermsDef(h, ss)
      BY DEF AgFS!WFDefOn
    <2>1. CASE ss = {}
      BY <2>1 DEF AgPermsDef
    <2>2. CASE ss # {}
      <3>1. \A x \in ss : g[ss \ {x}] = h[ss \ {x}]
        <4> SUFFICES ASSUME NEW x \in ss PROVE g[ss \ {x}] = h[ss \ {x}]
          OBVIOUS
        <4>1. ss \ {x} \in SUBSET S
          OBVIOUS
        <4>2. <<ss \ {x}, ss>> \in R
          BY DEF AgFS!StrictSubsetOrdering
        <4>3. ss \ {x} \in AgFS!SetLessThan(ss, R, SUBSET S)
          BY <4>1, <4>2 DEF AgFS!SetLessThan
        <4> QED BY <4>3
      <3> QED BY <3>1, <2>2 DEF AgPermsDef
    <2> QED BY <2>1, <2>2
  <1>3. AgFS!OpDefinesFcn(AgPerms(S), SUBSET S, AgPermsDef)
    BY DEF AgFS!OpDefinesFcn, AgPerms
  <1>4. AgFS!WFInductiveDefines(AgPerms(S), SUBSET S, AgPermsDef)
    BY <1>1, <1>2, <1>3, AgFS!WFInductiveDef
  <1> QED BY <1>4 DEF AgFS!WFInductiveDefines

LEMMA AgBridgeSeqOps ==
  /\ \A S : AgSeqT!Seq(S) = Seq(S)
  /\ \A s : AgSeqT!Len(s) = Len(s)
  /\ \A s, e : AgSeqT!Append(s, e) = Append(s, e)
  BY DEF AgSeqT!Seq, Seq, AgSeqT!Len, Len, AgSeqT!Append, Append

LEMMA AgLenOfFcn ==
  ASSUME NEW n \in Nat, NEW T, NEW f \in [1..n -> T]
  PROVE  /\ Len(f) = n
         /\ f \in Seq(T)
  <1>1. DOMAIN f = 1..n
    OBVIOUS
  <1>2. \A k \in Nat : (DOMAIN f = 1..k) => k = n
    <2> SUFFICES ASSUME NEW k \in Nat, 1..k = 1..n PROVE k = n
      BY <1>1
    <2>1. CASE k = 0
      <3>1. 1..n = {}
        BY <2>1
      <3> QED BY <3>1, <2>1
    <2>2. CASE k > 0
      <3>1. k \in 1..n
        BY <2>2
      <3>2. n > 0
        BY <3>1
      <3>3. n \in 1..k
        BY <3>2
      <3> QED BY <3>1, <3>3
    <2> QED BY <2>1, <2>2
  <1>3. Len(f) = n
    BY <1>1, <1>2 DEF Len
  <1>4. f \in Seq(T)
    BY DEF Seq
  <1> QED BY <1>3, <1>4

(***************************************************************************)
(* Bijective enumerations of a finite set.                                 *)
(***************************************************************************)
AgIsEnum(sq, ss) ==
  /\ sq \in [1..Cardinality(ss) -> ss]
  /\ \A i, j \in 1..Cardinality(ss) : sq[i] = sq[j] => i = j
  /\ \A e \in ss : \E i \in 1..Cardinality(ss) : sq[i] = e

LEMMA AgEnumInPerms ==
  ASSUME NEW S, IsFiniteSet(S)
  PROVE  \A ss \in SUBSET S : \A sq : AgIsEnum(sq, ss) => sq \in AgPerms(S)[ss]
  <1> DEFINE R == AgFS!StrictSubsetOrdering(S)
  <1> DEFINE SubS == SUBSET S
  <1> DEFINE P(ss) == \A sq : AgIsEnum(sq, ss) => sq \in AgPerms(S)[ss]
  <1>wf. AgFS!IsWellFoundedOn(R, SubS)
    BY AgSSOWellFounded
  <1>st. ASSUME NEW ss \in SUBSET S,
                \A u \in AgFS!SetLessThan(ss, R, SUBSET S) : P(u)
         PROVE  P(ss)
    <2> SUFFICES ASSUME NEW sq, AgIsEnum(sq, ss) PROVE sq \in AgPerms(S)[ss]
      OBVIOUS
    <2>fin. IsFiniteSet(ss)
      BY AgFS!FS_Subset, AgBridgeFinite
    <2>card. Cardinality(ss) \in Nat
      BY <2>fin, AgFS!FS_CardinalityType, AgBridgeFinite, AgBridgeCard
    <2>unf. AgPerms(S)[ss] = AgPermsDef(AgPerms(S), ss)
      BY AgPermsRec
    <2>1. CASE ss = {}
      <3>1. Cardinality(ss) = 0
        BY <2>1, AgFS!FS_EmptySet, AgBridgeCard
      <3>2. sq \in [1..0 -> {}]
        BY <3>1, <2>1 DEF AgIsEnum
      <3>3. sq \in Seq({}) /\ Len(sq) = 0
        BY <3>2, AgLenOfFcn
      <3>4. sq = << >>
        BY <3>3, AgSeqT!EmptySeq, AgBridgeSeqOps
      <3>5. AgPermsDef(AgPerms(S), ss) = { << >> }
        BY <2>1 DEF AgPermsDef
      <3> QED BY <3>4, <3>5, <2>unf
    <2>2. CASE ss # {}
      <3> DEFINE m == Cardinality(ss)
      <3>m1. m \in Nat /\ m > 0
        BY <2>card, <2>fin, <2>2, AgFS!FS_EmptySet, AgBridgeCard, AgBridgeFinite
      <3>sq. sq \in [1..m -> ss]
        BY DEF AgIsEnum
      <3>inj. \A i, j \in 1..m : sq[i] = sq[j] => i = j
        BY DEF AgIsEnum
      <3>sur. \A e \in ss : \E i \in 1..m : sq[i] = e
        BY DEF AgIsEnum
      <3> DEFINE x == sq[m]
      <3> DEFINE ss2 == ss \ {x}
      <3> DEFINE sq2 == [i \in 1..(m-1) |-> sq[i]]
      <3>x. x \in ss
        BY <3>sq, <3>m1
      <3>c2. Cardinality(ss2) = m - 1
        BY <2>fin, <3>x, AgFS!FS_RemoveElement, AgBridgeCard, AgBridgeFinite
      <3>nm. m - 1 \in Nat
        BY <3>m1
      <3>e2. AgIsEnum(sq2, ss2)
        <4>1. \A i \in 1..(m-1) : sq[i] \in ss2
          <5> SUFFICES ASSUME NEW i \in 1..(m-1) PROVE sq[i] \in ss2
            OBVIOUS
          <5>1. i \in 1..m /\ i # m
            BY <3>m1
          <5>2. sq[i] \in ss
            BY <3>sq, <5>1
          <5>3. sq[i] # x
            BY <3>inj, <5>1, <3>m1
          <5> QED BY <5>2, <5>3
        <4>2. sq2 \in [1..Cardinality(ss2) -> ss2]
          BY <4>1, <3>c2
        <4>3. \A i, j \in 1..Cardinality(ss2) : sq2[i] = sq2[j] => i = j
          <5> SUFFICES ASSUME NEW i \in 1..(m-1), NEW j \in 1..(m-1), sq2[i] = sq2[j]
                       PROVE  i = j
            BY <3>c2
          <5>1. sq[i] = sq[j]
            OBVIOUS
          <5> QED BY <5>1, <3>inj, <3>m1
        <4>4. \A e \in ss2 : \E i \in 1..Cardinality(ss2) : sq2[i] = e
          <5> SUFFICES ASSUME NEW e \in ss2 PROVE \E i \in 1..(m-1) : sq2[i] = e
            BY <3>c2
          <5>1. \E i \in 1..m : sq[i] = e
            BY <3>sur
          <5>2. PICK i \in 1..m : sq[i] = e
            BY <5>1
          <5>3. i # m
            BY <5>2
          <5>4. i \in 1..(m-1)
            BY <5>3, <3>m1
          <5> QED BY <5>2, <5>4
        <4> QED BY <4>2, <4>3, <4>4 DEF AgIsEnum
      <3>lt. ss2 \in AgFS!SetLessThan(ss, R, SUBSET S)
        BY <3>x DEF AgFS!SetLessThan, AgFS!StrictSubsetOrdering
      <3>ih. sq2 \in AgPerms(S)[ss2]
        BY <3>lt, <3>e2, <1>st
      <3>ap. Append(sq2, x) = sq
        <4>0. sq2 \in [1..(m-1) -> ss]
          BY <3>sq, <3>m1
        <4>1. sq2 \in Seq(ss) /\ Len(sq2) = m - 1
          BY <4>0, <3>nm, AgLenOfFcn
        <4>2. /\ Append(sq2, x) \in Seq(ss)
              /\ Len(Append(sq2, x)) = (m-1) + 1
              /\ \A i \in 1..(m-1) : Append(sq2, x)[i] = sq2[i]
              /\ Append(sq2, x)[(m-1)+1] = x
          BY <4>1, <3>x, AgSeqT!AppendProperties, AgBridgeSeqOps
        <4>3. Append(sq2, x) \in [1..m -> ss]
          BY <4>2, <3>m1, AgSeqT!LenProperties, AgBridgeSeqOps
        <4>4. \A i \in 1..m : Append(sq2, x)[i] = sq[i]
          <5> SUFFICES ASSUME NEW i \in 1..m PROVE Append(sq2, x)[i] = sq[i]
            OBVIOUS
          <5>1. CASE i = m
            BY <5>1, <4>2, <3>m1
          <5>2. CASE i # m
            <6>1. i \in 1..(m-1)
              BY <5>2, <3>m1
            <6>2. Append(sq2, x)[i] = sq2[i]
              BY <6>1, <4>2
            <6> QED BY <6>1, <6>2
          <5> QED BY <5>1, <5>2
        <4> QED BY <4>3, <4>4, <3>sq
      <3>in. Append(sq2, x) \in AgPermsDef(AgPerms(S), ss)
        <4>1. Append(sq2, x) \in { Append(q, x) : q \in AgPerms(S)[ss \ {x}] }
          BY <3>ih
        <4>2. { Append(q, x) : q \in AgPerms(S)[ss \ {x}] }
                \in { { Append(q, y) : q \in AgPerms(S)[ss \ {y}] } : y \in ss }
          BY <3>x
        <4> QED BY <4>1, <4>2, <2>2 DEF AgPermsDef
      <3> QED BY <3>ap, <3>in, <2>unf
    <2> QED BY <2>1, <2>2
  <1>2. \A ss \in SubS : (\A u \in AgFS!SetLessThan(ss, R, SubS) : P(u)) => P(ss)
    BY <1>st
  <1> HIDE DEF P, SubS
  <1>3. \A ss \in SubS : P(ss)
    BY ONLY <1>wf, <1>2, AgFS!WFInduction, AgT!IsaM("blast")
  <1> QED BY <1>3 DEF P, SubS
LEMMA AgEnumInPermSeqs ==
  ASSUME NEW T, IsFiniteSet(T), NEW sq, AgIsEnum(sq, T)
  PROVE  sq \in PermSeqs(T)
  BY AgEnumInPerms, AgPermSeqsUnfold

LEMMA AgFcnToSeq ==
  ASSUME NEW n \in Nat, NEW f, f = [i \in 1..n |-> f[i]]
  PROVE  /\ f \in Seq({f[i] : i \in 1..n})
         /\ Len(f) = n
  <1>1. f \in [1..n -> {f[i] : i \in 1..n}]
    OBVIOUS
  <1> QED BY <1>1, AgLenOfFcn

LEMMA AgEnumAppend ==
  ASSUME NEW ss, IsFiniteSet(ss), NEW x \in ss, NEW sq2, AgIsEnum(sq2, ss \ {x})
  PROVE  AgIsEnum(Append(sq2, x), ss)
  <1> DEFINE m == Cardinality(ss)
  <1>fin. IsFiniteSet(ss \ {x})
    BY AgFS!FS_RemoveElement, AgBridgeFinite
  <1>m1. m \in Nat /\ m > 0
    BY AgFS!FS_CardinalityType, AgFS!FS_EmptySet, AgBridgeFinite, AgBridgeCard
  <1>c2. Cardinality(ss \ {x}) = m - 1
    BY AgFS!FS_RemoveElement, AgBridgeFinite, AgBridgeCard
  <1>nm. m - 1 \in Nat
    BY <1>m1
  <1>sq2. sq2 \in [1..(m-1) -> ss \ {x}]
    BY <1>c2 DEF AgIsEnum
  <1>seq. sq2 \in Seq(ss) /\ Len(sq2) = m - 1
    <2>1. sq2 \in [1..(m-1) -> ss]
      BY <1>sq2
    <2> QED BY <2>1, <1>nm, AgLenOfFcn
  <1>ap. /\ Append(sq2, x) \in Seq(ss)
         /\ Len(Append(sq2, x)) = (m-1) + 1
         /\ \A i \in 1..(m-1) : Append(sq2, x)[i] = sq2[i]
         /\ Append(sq2, x)[(m-1)+1] = x
    BY <1>seq, AgSeqT!AppendProperties, AgBridgeSeqOps
  <1>dom. Append(sq2, x) \in [1..m -> ss]
    BY <1>ap, <1>m1, AgSeqT!LenProperties, AgBridgeSeqOps
  <1>inj. \A i, j \in 1..m : Append(sq2,x)[i] = Append(sq2,x)[j] => i = j
    <2> SUFFICES ASSUME NEW i \in 1..m, NEW j \in 1..m,
                        Append(sq2,x)[i] = Append(sq2,x)[j], i # j
                 PROVE  FALSE
      OBVIOUS
    <2>1. CASE i = m /\ j # m
      <3>1. j \in 1..(m-1)
        BY <2>1, <1>m1
      <3>2. Append(sq2,x)[j] = sq2[j]
        BY <3>1, <1>ap
      <3>3. sq2[j] \in ss \ {x}
        BY <3>1, <1>sq2
      <3> QED BY <2>1, <3>2, <3>3, <1>ap, <1>m1
    <2>2. CASE j = m /\ i # m
      <3>1. i \in 1..(m-1)
        BY <2>2, <1>m1
      <3>2. Append(sq2,x)[i] = sq2[i]
        BY <3>1, <1>ap
      <3>3. sq2[i] \in ss \ {x}
        BY <3>1, <1>sq2
      <3> QED BY <2>2, <3>2, <3>3, <1>ap, <1>m1
    <2>3. CASE i # m /\ j # m
      <3>1. i \in 1..(m-1) /\ j \in 1..(m-1)
        BY <2>3, <1>m1
      <3>2. sq2[i] = sq2[j]
        BY <3>1, <1>ap
      <3> QED BY <3>1, <3>2, <1>c2 DEF AgIsEnum
    <2> QED BY <2>1, <2>2, <2>3
  <1>sur. \A e \in ss : \E i \in 1..m : Append(sq2,x)[i] = e
    <2> SUFFICES ASSUME NEW e \in ss PROVE \E i \in 1..m : Append(sq2,x)[i] = e
      OBVIOUS
    <2>1. CASE e = x
      BY <2>1, <1>ap, <1>m1
    <2>2. CASE e # x
      <3>1. e \in ss \ {x}
        BY <2>2
      <3>2. \E i \in 1..(m-1) : sq2[i] = e
        BY <3>1, <1>c2 DEF AgIsEnum
      <3> QED BY <3>2, <1>ap, <1>m1
    <2> QED BY <2>1, <2>2
  <1> QED BY <1>dom, <1>inj, <1>sur DEF AgIsEnum

(***************************************************************************)
(* The accumulator shape produced by the fold inside CC!executions.        *)
(***************************************************************************)
AgCh(s) == CHOOSE x \in s : TRUE

AgAcc0(IS) == [ execution |-> << >>, nextState |-> IS ]

AgStep(t, acc) ==
  [ execution |-> Append(acc.execution, [parentState |-> acc.nextState, transaction |-> t]),
    nextState |-> CC!effects(acc.nextState, t) ]

AgGen(IS, acc, n) ==
  /\ acc = [execution |-> acc.execution, nextState |-> acc.nextState]
  /\ acc.execution = [k \in 1..n |-> acc.execution[k]]
  /\ \A k \in 1..n : acc.execution[k] = [parentState |-> acc.execution[k].parentState,
                                         transaction |-> acc.execution[k].transaction]
  /\ \A k \in 1..n : acc.execution[k].parentState
                       = IF k = 1 THEN IS
                         ELSE CC!effects(acc.execution[k-1].parentState,
                                         acc.execution[k-1].transaction)
  /\ acc.nextState = IF n = 0 THEN IS
                     ELSE CC!effects(acc.execution[n].parentState, acc.execution[n].transaction)

LEMMA AgGenZero == \A IS : AgGen(IS, AgAcc0(IS), 0)
  <1> SUFFICES ASSUME NEW IS PROVE AgGen(IS, AgAcc0(IS), 0)
    OBVIOUS
  <1>1. << >> = [k \in 1..0 |-> << >>[k]]
    OBVIOUS
  <1> QED BY <1>1 DEF AgGen, AgAcc0

LEMMA AgGenStep ==
  ASSUME NEW IS, NEW acc, NEW n \in Nat, AgGen(IS, acc, n), NEW t
  PROVE  /\ AgGen(IS, AgStep(t, acc), n+1)
         /\ \A k \in 1..n : AgStep(t, acc).execution[k] = acc.execution[k]
         /\ AgStep(t, acc).execution[n+1] = [parentState |-> acc.nextState, transaction |-> t]
  <1> DEFINE e0 == acc.execution
  <1> DEFINE nw == [parentState |-> acc.nextState, transaction |-> t]
  <1> DEFINE e1 == Append(e0, nw)
  <1>dom. e0 = [k \in 1..n |-> e0[k]]
    BY DEF AgGen
  <1>seq. e0 \in Seq({e0[i] : i \in 1..n}) /\ Len(e0) = n
    BY <1>dom, AgFcnToSeq
  <1>big. e0 \in Seq({e0[i] : i \in 1..n} \cup {nw}) /\ nw \in {e0[i] : i \in 1..n} \cup {nw}
    BY <1>seq, AgSeqT!SeqMonotonic, AgBridgeSeqOps
  <1>apr. /\ e1 \in Seq({e0[i] : i \in 1..n} \cup {nw})
          /\ Len(e1) = Len(e0) + 1
          /\ \A k \in 1..Len(e0) : e1[k] = e0[k]
          /\ e1[Len(e0)+1] = nw
    BY <1>big, AgSeqT!AppendProperties, AgBridgeSeqOps
  <1>ap. /\ Len(e1) = n + 1
         /\ \A k \in 1..n : e1[k] = e0[k]
         /\ e1[n+1] = nw
    BY <1>apr, <1>seq
  <1>dom1. e1 = [k \in 1..(n+1) |-> e1[k]]
    <2>1. e1 \in [1..Len(e1) -> {e0[i] : i \in 1..n} \cup {nw}]
      BY <1>apr, AgSeqT!LenProperties, AgBridgeSeqOps
    <2> QED BY <2>1, <1>ap
  <1>rec. \A k \in 1..(n+1) : e1[k] = [parentState |-> e1[k].parentState, transaction |-> e1[k].transaction]
    <2> SUFFICES ASSUME NEW k \in 1..(n+1) PROVE e1[k] = [parentState |-> e1[k].parentState, transaction |-> e1[k].transaction]
      OBVIOUS
    <2>1. CASE k \in 1..n
      BY <2>1, <1>ap DEF AgGen
    <2>2. CASE k = n+1
      BY <2>2, <1>ap
    <2> QED BY <2>1, <2>2
  <1>par. \A k \in 1..(n+1) : e1[k].parentState
            = IF k = 1 THEN IS ELSE CC!effects(e1[k-1].parentState, e1[k-1].transaction)
    <2> SUFFICES ASSUME NEW k \in 1..(n+1)
                 PROVE  e1[k].parentState = IF k = 1 THEN IS ELSE CC!effects(e1[k-1].parentState, e1[k-1].transaction)
      OBVIOUS
    <2>1. CASE k \in 1..n
      <3>1. e1[k] = e0[k]
        BY <2>1, <1>ap
      <3>2. CASE k = 1
        BY <3>1, <3>2, <2>1 DEF AgGen
      <3>3. CASE k # 1
        <4>1. k - 1 \in 1..n
          BY <2>1, <3>3
        <4>2. e1[k-1] = e0[k-1]
          BY <4>1, <1>ap
        <4> QED BY <3>1, <3>3, <4>2, <2>1 DEF AgGen
      <3> QED BY <3>2, <3>3
    <2>2. CASE k = n+1
      <3>1. e1[k] = nw
        BY <2>2, <1>ap
      <3>2. CASE n = 0
        BY <3>1, <3>2, <2>2 DEF AgGen
      <3>3. CASE n # 0
        <4>1. k - 1 = n /\ n \in 1..n
          BY <2>2, <3>3
        <4>2. e1[k-1] = e0[n]
          BY <4>1, <1>ap
        <4> QED BY <3>1, <3>3, <4>1, <4>2, <2>2 DEF AgGen
      <3> QED BY <3>2, <3>3
    <2> QED BY <2>1, <2>2
  <1>nxt. CC!effects(acc.nextState, t) = CC!effects(e1[n+1].parentState, e1[n+1].transaction)
    BY <1>ap
  <1>shape. AgStep(t, acc) = [execution |-> e1, nextState |-> CC!effects(acc.nextState, t)]
    BY DEF AgStep
  <1> QED BY <1>shape, <1>dom1, <1>rec, <1>par, <1>nxt, <1>ap DEF AgGen

LEMMA AgBridgeFold == \A S : AgFold!IsFiniteSet(S) <=> IsFiniteSet(S)
  BY DEF AgFold!IsFiniteSet, IsFiniteSet

LEMMA AgChIn == \A V : \A W \in SUBSET V : W # {} => AgCh(W) \in W
  BY DEF AgCh

LEMMA AgBridgeMTFS ==
  ASSUME NEW op(_,_), NEW base, NEW f(_), NEW ch(_), NEW S
  PROVE  AgFold!MapThenFoldSet(op, base, f, ch, S) = MapThenFoldSet(op, base, f, ch, S)
  BY DEF AgFold!MapThenFoldSet, MapThenFoldSet

LEMMA AgMTFSEmpty ==
  ASSUME NEW op(_,_), NEW base, NEW f(_), NEW ch(_)
  PROVE  MapThenFoldSet(op, base, f, ch, {}) = base
  BY AgFold!MapThenFoldSetEmpty, AgBridgeMTFS

LEMMA AgMTFSNonempty ==
  ASSUME NEW op(_,_), NEW base, NEW f(_), NEW S, S # {}, IsFiniteSet(S)
  PROVE  MapThenFoldSet(op, base, f, AgCh, S)
           = op(f(AgCh(S)), MapThenFoldSet(op, base, f, AgCh, S \ {AgCh(S)}))
  <1>1. \A T \in SUBSET S : T # {} => AgCh(T) \in T
    BY AgChIn
  <1>2. AgFold!IsFiniteSet(S)
    BY AgBridgeFold
  <1>3. AgFold!MapThenFoldSet(op, base, f, AgCh, S)
          = op(f(AgCh(S)), AgFold!MapThenFoldSet(op, base, f, AgCh, S \ {AgCh(S)}))
    BY <1>1, <1>2, AgFold!MapThenFoldSetNonempty
  <1> QED BY <1>3, AgBridgeMTFS

LEMMA AgEnumEmpty == AgIsEnum(<< >>, {})
  <1>1. Cardinality({}) = 0
    BY AgFS!FS_EmptySet, AgBridgeCard
  <1>2. << >> \in [1..0 -> {}]
    OBVIOUS
  <1> QED BY <1>1, <1>2 DEF AgIsEnum

LEMMA AgFoldStruct ==
  ASSUME NEW U, IsFiniteSet(U)
  PROVE  \E cs :
           /\ AgIsEnum(cs, U)
           /\ \A IS, o :
                /\ AgGen(IS, MapThenFoldSet(AgStep, AgAcc0(IS), LAMBDA i : o[i], AgCh, U),
                         Cardinality(U))
                /\ \A k \in 1..Cardinality(U) :
                     MapThenFoldSet(AgStep, AgAcc0(IS), LAMBDA i : o[i], AgCh, U).execution[k].transaction
                       = o[cs[k]]
  <1> DEFINE P(V) ==
        \E cs :
          /\ AgIsEnum(cs, V)
          /\ \A IS, o :
               /\ AgGen(IS, MapThenFoldSet(AgStep, AgAcc0(IS), LAMBDA i : o[i], AgCh, V),
                        Cardinality(V))
               /\ \A k \in 1..Cardinality(V) :
                    MapThenFoldSet(AgStep, AgAcc0(IS), LAMBDA i : o[i], AgCh, V).execution[k].transaction
                      = o[cs[k]]
  <1>st. ASSUME NEW V \in SUBSET U, \A W \in (SUBSET V) \ {V} : P(W)
         PROVE  P(V)
    <2>fin. IsFiniteSet(V)
      BY AgFS!FS_Subset, AgBridgeFinite
    <2>card. Cardinality(V) \in Nat
      BY <2>fin, AgFS!FS_CardinalityType, AgBridgeFinite, AgBridgeCard
    <2>1. CASE V = {}
      <3>1. Cardinality(V) = 0
        BY <2>1, AgFS!FS_EmptySet, AgBridgeCard
      <3>2. AgIsEnum(<< >>, V)
        BY <2>1, AgEnumEmpty
      <3>3. ASSUME NEW IS, NEW o
            PROVE  /\ AgGen(IS, MapThenFoldSet(AgStep, AgAcc0(IS), LAMBDA i : o[i], AgCh, V),
                            Cardinality(V))
                   /\ \A k \in 1..Cardinality(V) :
                        MapThenFoldSet(AgStep, AgAcc0(IS), LAMBDA i : o[i], AgCh, V).execution[k].transaction
                          = o[<< >>[k]]
        <4>1. MapThenFoldSet(AgStep, AgAcc0(IS), LAMBDA i : o[i], AgCh, V) = AgAcc0(IS)
          BY <2>1, AgMTFSEmpty
        <4>2. AgGen(IS, AgAcc0(IS), 0)
          BY AgGenZero
        <4> QED BY <4>1, <4>2, <3>1
      <3> QED BY <3>2, <3>3
    <2>2. CASE V # {}
      <3> DEFINE x == AgCh(V)
      <3> DEFINE W == V \ {x}
      <3>x. x \in V
        BY <2>2, AgChIn
      <3>w. W \in (SUBSET V) \ {V}
        BY <3>x
      <3>finW. IsFiniteSet(W)
        BY <2>fin, AgFS!FS_RemoveElement, AgBridgeFinite
      <3>cw. Cardinality(W) = Cardinality(V) - 1
        BY <2>fin, <3>x, AgFS!FS_RemoveElement, AgBridgeFinite, AgBridgeCard
      <3>cwn. Cardinality(W) \in Nat /\ Cardinality(V) = Cardinality(W) + 1
        <4>1. Cardinality(W) \in Nat
          BY <3>finW, AgFS!FS_CardinalityType, AgBridgeFinite, AgBridgeCard
        <4>2. Cardinality(V) # 0
          BY <2>2, <2>fin, AgFS!FS_EmptySet, AgBridgeCard, AgBridgeFinite
        <4> QED BY <4>1, <4>2, <3>cw, <2>card
      <3>ih. PICK cs2 :
               /\ AgIsEnum(cs2, W)
               /\ \A IS, o :
                    /\ AgGen(IS, MapThenFoldSet(AgStep, AgAcc0(IS), LAMBDA i : o[i], AgCh, W),
                             Cardinality(W))
                    /\ \A k \in 1..Cardinality(W) :
                         MapThenFoldSet(AgStep, AgAcc0(IS), LAMBDA i : o[i], AgCh, W).execution[k].transaction
                           = o[cs2[k]]
        BY <3>w, <1>st
      <3> DEFINE cs == Append(cs2, x)
      <3>e. AgIsEnum(cs, V)
        BY <2>fin, <3>x, <3>ih, AgEnumAppend
      <3>cs2seq. cs2 \in Seq(V) /\ Len(cs2) = Cardinality(W)
        <4>1. cs2 \in [1..Cardinality(W) -> V]
          BY <3>ih DEF AgIsEnum
        <4> QED BY <4>1, <3>cwn, AgLenOfFcn
      <3>csap. /\ \A k \in 1..Cardinality(W) : cs[k] = cs2[k]
               /\ cs[Cardinality(W)+1] = x
        <4>1. /\ \A k \in 1..Len(cs2) : Append(cs2, x)[k] = cs2[k]
              /\ Append(cs2, x)[Len(cs2)+1] = x
          BY <3>cs2seq, <3>x, AgSeqT!AppendProperties, AgBridgeSeqOps
        <4> QED BY <4>1, <3>cs2seq
      <3>main. ASSUME NEW IS, NEW o
               PROVE  /\ AgGen(IS, MapThenFoldSet(AgStep, AgAcc0(IS), LAMBDA i : o[i], AgCh, V),
                               Cardinality(V))
                      /\ \A k \in 1..Cardinality(V) :
                           MapThenFoldSet(AgStep, AgAcc0(IS), LAMBDA i : o[i], AgCh, V).execution[k].transaction
                             = o[cs[k]]
        <4> DEFINE resW == MapThenFoldSet(AgStep, AgAcc0(IS), LAMBDA i : o[i], AgCh, W)
        <4> DEFINE resV == MapThenFoldSet(AgStep, AgAcc0(IS), LAMBDA i : o[i], AgCh, V)
        <4>unf. resV = AgStep(o[x], resW)
          BY <2>2, <2>fin, AgMTFSNonempty
        <4>ihg. /\ AgGen(IS, resW, Cardinality(W))
                /\ \A k \in 1..Cardinality(W) : resW.execution[k].transaction = o[cs2[k]]
          BY <3>ih
        <4>gs. /\ AgGen(IS, AgStep(o[x], resW), Cardinality(W)+1)
               /\ \A k \in 1..Cardinality(W) : AgStep(o[x], resW).execution[k] = resW.execution[k]
               /\ AgStep(o[x], resW).execution[Cardinality(W)+1]
                    = [parentState |-> resW.nextState, transaction |-> o[x]]
          BY <4>ihg, <3>cwn, AgGenStep
        <4>1. AgGen(IS, resV, Cardinality(V))
          BY <4>unf, <4>gs, <3>cwn
        <4>2. \A k \in 1..Cardinality(V) : resV.execution[k].transaction = o[cs[k]]
          <5> SUFFICES ASSUME NEW k \in 1..Cardinality(V)
                       PROVE  resV.execution[k].transaction = o[cs[k]]
            OBVIOUS
          <5>1. CASE k \in 1..Cardinality(W)
            <6>1. resV.execution[k] = resW.execution[k]
              BY <4>unf, <4>gs, <5>1
            <6> QED BY <6>1, <4>ihg, <5>1, <3>csap
          <5>2. CASE k = Cardinality(W) + 1
            <6>1. resV.execution[k] = [parentState |-> resW.nextState, transaction |-> o[x]]
              BY <4>unf, <4>gs, <5>2
            <6> QED BY <6>1, <5>2, <3>csap
          <5> QED BY <5>1, <5>2, <3>cwn
        <4> QED BY <4>1, <4>2
      <3> QED BY <3>e, <3>main
    <2> QED BY <2>1, <2>2
  <1> HIDE DEF P
  <1>2. P(U)
    BY ONLY <1>st, AgBridgeFinite, AgFS!FS_WFInduction, AgT!IsaM("blast"), IsFiniteSet(U)
  <1> QED BY <1>2 DEF P

(***************************************************************************)
(* CC!executions, unfolded, and the existence of a chosen-order execution. *)
(***************************************************************************)
LEMMA AgExecUnfold ==
  ASSUME NEW IS, NEW T
  PROVE  CC!executions(IS, T)
           = { MapThenFoldSet(AgStep, AgAcc0(IS), LAMBDA i : ord[i], AgCh, DOMAIN ord).execution
               : ord \in PermSeqs(T) }
  BY DEF CC!executions, CC!PermSeqs, PermSeqs, CC!ReduceSeq, CC!FoldFunction,
         CC!FoldFunctionOnSet, CC!MapThenFoldSet, MapThenFoldSet, AgStep, AgAcc0, AgCh

AgGenE(IS, E, n) ==
  /\ E = [k \in 1..n |-> E[k]]
  /\ \A k \in 1..n : E[k] = [parentState |-> E[k].parentState, transaction |-> E[k].transaction]
  /\ \A k \in 1..n : E[k].parentState
                       = IF k = 1 THEN IS
                         ELSE CC!effects(E[k-1].parentState, E[k-1].transaction)

LEMMA AgExecExists ==
  ASSUME NEW IS, NEW T, IsFiniteSet(T), NEW D, AgIsEnum(D, T)
  PROVE  \E E : /\ E \in CC!executions(IS, T)
                /\ AgGenE(IS, E, Cardinality(T))
                /\ \A k \in 1..Cardinality(T) : E[k].transaction = D[k]
  <1> DEFINE n == Cardinality(T)
  <1>n. n \in Nat
    BY AgFS!FS_CardinalityType, AgBridgeFinite, AgBridgeCard
  <1>fi. IsFiniteSet(1..n) /\ Cardinality(1..n) = n
    BY <1>n, AgFS!FS_Interval, AgBridgeFinite, AgBridgeCard
  <1>fs. PICK cs :
           /\ AgIsEnum(cs, 1..n)
           /\ \A ISx, o :
                /\ AgGen(ISx, MapThenFoldSet(AgStep, AgAcc0(ISx), LAMBDA i : o[i], AgCh, 1..n),
                         Cardinality(1..n))
                /\ \A k \in 1..Cardinality(1..n) :
                     MapThenFoldSet(AgStep, AgAcc0(ISx), LAMBDA i : o[i], AgCh, 1..n).execution[k].transaction
                       = o[cs[k]]
    BY <1>fi, AgFoldStruct
  <1>cs. /\ cs \in [1..n -> 1..n]
         /\ \A i, j \in 1..n : cs[i] = cs[j] => i = j
         /\ \A e \in 1..n : \E i \in 1..n : cs[i] = e
    BY <1>fs, <1>fi DEF AgIsEnum
  <1> DEFINE inv(i) == CHOOSE k \in 1..n : cs[k] = i
  <1>inv. \A i \in 1..n : inv(i) \in 1..n /\ cs[inv(i)] = i
    BY <1>cs
  <1> DEFINE o == [i \in 1..n |-> D[inv(i)]]
  <1>D. /\ D \in [1..n -> T]
        /\ \A i, j \in 1..n : D[i] = D[j] => i = j
        /\ \A e \in T : \E i \in 1..n : D[i] = e
    BY DEF AgIsEnum
  <1>oe. AgIsEnum(o, T)
    <2>1. o \in [1..n -> T]
      BY <1>inv, <1>D
    <2>2. \A i, j \in 1..n : o[i] = o[j] => i = j
      <3> SUFFICES ASSUME NEW i \in 1..n, NEW j \in 1..n, o[i] = o[j] PROVE i = j
        OBVIOUS
      <3>1. D[inv(i)] = D[inv(j)]
        OBVIOUS
      <3>2. inv(i) = inv(j)
        BY <3>1, <1>inv, <1>D
      <3> QED BY <3>2, <1>inv
    <2>3. \A e \in T : \E i \in 1..n : o[i] = e
      <3> SUFFICES ASSUME NEW e \in T PROVE \E i \in 1..n : o[i] = e
        OBVIOUS
      <3>1. PICK k \in 1..n : D[k] = e
        BY <1>D
      <3>2. cs[k] \in 1..n
        BY <1>cs
      <3>3. inv(cs[k]) = k
        BY <3>2, <1>inv, <1>cs
      <3> QED BY <3>1, <3>2, <3>3
    <2> QED BY <2>1, <2>2, <2>3 DEF AgIsEnum
  <1>op. o \in PermSeqs(T)
    BY <1>oe, AgEnumInPermSeqs
  <1>od. DOMAIN o = 1..n
    OBVIOUS
  <1> DEFINE res == MapThenFoldSet(AgStep, AgAcc0(IS), LAMBDA i : o[i], AgCh, 1..n)
  <1>1. res.execution \in CC!executions(IS, T)
    <2>1. res.execution
            \in { MapThenFoldSet(AgStep, AgAcc0(IS), LAMBDA i : ord[i], AgCh, DOMAIN ord).execution
                  : ord \in PermSeqs(T) }
      BY <1>op, <1>od
    <2> QED BY <2>1, AgExecUnfold
  <1>2. AgGen(IS, res, n) /\ \A k \in 1..n : res.execution[k].transaction = o[cs[k]]
    BY <1>fs, <1>fi
  <1>3. AgGenE(IS, res.execution, n)
    BY <1>2 DEF AgGen, AgGenE
  <1>4. \A k \in 1..n : res.execution[k].transaction = D[k]
    <2> SUFFICES ASSUME NEW k \in 1..n PROVE res.execution[k].transaction = D[k]
      OBVIOUS
    <2>1. cs[k] \in 1..n
      BY <1>cs
    <2>2. o[cs[k]] = D[inv(cs[k])]
      BY <2>1
    <2>3. inv(cs[k]) = k
      BY <2>1, <1>inv, <1>cs
    <2> QED BY <1>2, <2>2, <2>3
  <1> QED BY <1>1, <1>3, <1>4

(***************************************************************************)
(* INTERSECTION over a finite set of sets.                                 *)
(***************************************************************************)
AgIsectDef(X, g, s) == IF s = {} THEN UNION X ELSE AgCh(s) \cap g[s \ {AgCh(s)}]

AgIsectFcn(X) == CHOOSE f : f = [s \in SUBSET X |-> AgIsectDef(X, f, s)]

LEMMA AgIsectUnfold == \A X : INTERSECTION(X) = AgIsectFcn(X)[X]
  BY DEF INTERSECTION, ReduceSet, AgIsectFcn, AgIsectDef, AgCh

LEMMA AgIsectRec ==
  ASSUME NEW X, IsFiniteSet(X)
  PROVE  AgIsectFcn(X) = [s \in SUBSET X |-> AgIsectDef(X, AgIsectFcn(X), s)]
  <1> DEFINE R == AgFS!StrictSubsetOrdering(X)
  <1> DEFINE Dg(g, s) == AgIsectDef(X, g, s)
  <1>1. AgFS!IsWellFoundedOn(R, SUBSET X)
    BY AgSSOWellFounded
  <1>2. AgFS!WFDefOn(R, SUBSET X, Dg)
    <2> SUFFICES ASSUME NEW g, NEW h, NEW ss \in SUBSET X,
                        \A y \in AgFS!SetLessThan(ss, R, SUBSET X) : g[y] = h[y]
                 PROVE  Dg(g, ss) = Dg(h, ss)
      BY DEF AgFS!WFDefOn
    <2>1. CASE ss = {}
      BY <2>1 DEF AgIsectDef
    <2>2. CASE ss # {}
      <3>1. AgCh(ss) \in ss
        BY <2>2 DEF AgCh
      <3>2. ss \ {AgCh(ss)} \in AgFS!SetLessThan(ss, R, SUBSET X)
        BY <3>1 DEF AgFS!SetLessThan, AgFS!StrictSubsetOrdering
      <3> QED BY <3>2, <2>2 DEF AgIsectDef
    <2> QED BY <2>1, <2>2
  <1>3. AgFS!OpDefinesFcn(AgIsectFcn(X), SUBSET X, Dg)
    BY DEF AgFS!OpDefinesFcn, AgIsectFcn
  <1>4. AgFS!WFInductiveDefines(AgIsectFcn(X), SUBSET X, Dg)
    BY <1>1, <1>2, <1>3, AgFS!WFInductiveDef
  <1> QED BY <1>4 DEF AgFS!WFInductiveDefines

LEMMA AgIsectChar ==
  ASSUME NEW X, IsFiniteSet(X)
  PROVE  \A s \in SUBSET X :
           \A v : (v \in AgIsectFcn(X)[s]) <=> (v \in UNION X /\ \A Y \in s : v \in Y)
  <1> DEFINE R == AgFS!StrictSubsetOrdering(X)
  <1> DEFINE SubX == SUBSET X
  <1> DEFINE P(s) == \A v : (v \in AgIsectFcn(X)[s]) <=> (v \in UNION X /\ \A Y \in s : v \in Y)
  <1>wf. AgFS!IsWellFoundedOn(R, SubX)
    BY AgSSOWellFounded
  <1>st. ASSUME NEW s \in SubX, \A u \in AgFS!SetLessThan(s, R, SubX) : P(u)
         PROVE  P(s)
    <2>unf. AgIsectFcn(X)[s] = AgIsectDef(X, AgIsectFcn(X), s)
      BY AgIsectRec
    <2>1. CASE s = {}
      BY <2>1, <2>unf DEF AgIsectDef
    <2>2. CASE s # {}
      <3>x. AgCh(s) \in s
        BY <2>2 DEF AgCh
      <3>lt. s \ {AgCh(s)} \in AgFS!SetLessThan(s, R, SubX)
        BY <3>x DEF AgFS!SetLessThan, AgFS!StrictSubsetOrdering
      <3>ih. P(s \ {AgCh(s)})
        BY <3>lt, <1>st
      <3>e. AgIsectFcn(X)[s] = AgCh(s) \cap AgIsectFcn(X)[s \ {AgCh(s)}]
        BY <2>unf, <2>2 DEF AgIsectDef
      <3> QED BY <3>e, <3>ih, <3>x
    <2> QED BY <2>1, <2>2
  <1>2. \A s \in SubX : (\A u \in AgFS!SetLessThan(s, R, SubX) : P(u)) => P(s)
    BY <1>st
  <1> HIDE DEF P, SubX
  <1>3. \A s \in SubX : P(s)
    BY ONLY <1>wf, <1>2, AgFS!WFInduction, AgT!IsaM("blast")
  <1> QED BY <1>3 DEF P, SubX

LEMMA AgIntersection ==
  ASSUME NEW X, IsFiniteSet(X), NEW v
  PROVE  (v \in INTERSECTION(X)) <=> (v \in UNION X /\ \A Y \in X : v \in Y)
  BY AgIsectUnfold, AgIsectChar

LEMMA AgBridgeIsect == \A X : CC!INTERSECTION(X) = INTERSECTION(X)
  BY DEF CC!INTERSECTION, INTERSECTION, CC!ReduceSet, ReduceSet

(***************************************************************************)
(* The result of CC!effects on a transaction writing each key at most once.*)
(***************************************************************************)
AgEffOp(oo, st) == IF oo.op = "write" THEN [st EXCEPT ![oo.key] = oo.value] ELSE st

LEMMA AgEffectsUnfold ==
  ASSUME NEW st, NEW t
  PROVE  CC!effects(st, t) = MapThenFoldSet(AgEffOp, st, LAMBDA i : t[i], AgCh, DOMAIN t)
  BY DEF CC!effects, CC!ReduceSeq, CC!FoldFunction, CC!FoldFunctionOnSet,
         CC!MapThenFoldSet, MapThenFoldSet, AgEffOp, AgCh

AgWrites(t, k) == \E i \in DOMAIN t : t[i].op = "write" /\ t[i].key = k
AgWVal(t, k) == t[CHOOSE i \in DOMAIN t : t[i].op = "write" /\ t[i].key = k].value

LEMMA AgEffectsChar ==
  ASSUME NEW st, NEW t, NEW n \in Nat, DOMAIN t = 1..n,
         st = [k \in DOMAIN st |-> st[k]],
         WritesEachKeyAtMostOnce(t)
  PROVE  CC!effects(st, t) = [k \in DOMAIN st |-> IF AgWrites(t,k) THEN AgWVal(t,k) ELSE st[k]]
  <1> DEFINE R == AgFS!StrictSubsetOrdering(1..n)
  <1> DEFINE SubN == SUBSET (1..n)
  <1> DEFINE P(U) ==
        MapThenFoldSet(AgEffOp, st, LAMBDA i : t[i], AgCh, U)
          = [k \in DOMAIN st |-> IF (\E i \in U : t[i].op = "write" /\ t[i].key = k)
                                   THEN AgWVal(t,k) ELSE st[k]]
  <1>fin. IsFiniteSet(1..n)
    BY AgFS!FS_Interval, AgBridgeFinite
  <1>wf. AgFS!IsWellFoundedOn(R, SubN)
    BY <1>fin, AgSSOWellFounded
  <1>uniq. \A i \in 1..n : t[i].op = "write" =>
             (CHOOSE j \in DOMAIN t : t[j].op = "write" /\ t[j].key = t[i].key) = i
    <2> SUFFICES ASSUME NEW i \in 1..n, t[i].op = "write"
                 PROVE  (CHOOSE j \in DOMAIN t : t[j].op = "write" /\ t[j].key = t[i].key) = i
      OBVIOUS
    <2>1. \A j \in DOMAIN t : (t[j].op = "write" /\ t[j].key = t[i].key) => j = i
      BY DEF WritesEachKeyAtMostOnce
    <2>2. i \in DOMAIN t /\ t[i].op = "write" /\ t[i].key = t[i].key
      OBVIOUS
    <2> QED BY <2>1, <2>2
  <1>st. ASSUME NEW U \in SubN, \A W \in AgFS!SetLessThan(U, R, SubN) : P(W)
         PROVE  P(U)
    <2>1. CASE U = {}
      <3>1. MapThenFoldSet(AgEffOp, st, LAMBDA i : t[i], AgCh, U) = st
        BY <2>1, AgMTFSEmpty
      <3> QED BY <3>1, <2>1
    <2>2. CASE U # {}
      <3> DEFINE x == AgCh(U)
      <3>x. x \in U /\ x \in 1..n
        BY <2>2, AgChIn
      <3>finU. IsFiniteSet(U)
        BY <1>fin, AgFS!FS_Subset, AgBridgeFinite
      <3>lt. U \ {x} \in AgFS!SetLessThan(U, R, SubN)
        BY <3>x DEF AgFS!SetLessThan, AgFS!StrictSubsetOrdering
      <3>ih. MapThenFoldSet(AgEffOp, st, LAMBDA i : t[i], AgCh, U \ {x})
               = [k \in DOMAIN st |-> IF (\E i \in U \ {x} : t[i].op = "write" /\ t[i].key = k)
                                        THEN AgWVal(t,k) ELSE st[k]]
        BY <3>lt, <1>st
      <3>unf. MapThenFoldSet(AgEffOp, st, LAMBDA i : t[i], AgCh, U)
                = AgEffOp(t[x], MapThenFoldSet(AgEffOp, st, LAMBDA i : t[i], AgCh, U \ {x}))
        BY <2>2, <3>finU, AgMTFSNonempty
      <3> DEFINE prev == [k \in DOMAIN st |-> IF (\E i \in U \ {x} : t[i].op = "write" /\ t[i].key = k)
                                                THEN AgWVal(t,k) ELSE st[k]]
      <3>a. CASE t[x].op # "write"
        <4>1. MapThenFoldSet(AgEffOp, st, LAMBDA i : t[i], AgCh, U) = prev
          BY <3>unf, <3>ih, <3>a DEF AgEffOp
        <4>2. \A k : (\E i \in U : t[i].op = "write" /\ t[i].key = k)
                       <=> (\E i \in U \ {x} : t[i].op = "write" /\ t[i].key = k)
          BY <3>a, <3>x
        <4> QED BY <4>1, <4>2
      <3>b. CASE t[x].op = "write"
        <4>1. MapThenFoldSet(AgEffOp, st, LAMBDA i : t[i], AgCh, U)
                = [prev EXCEPT ![t[x].key] = t[x].value]
          BY <3>unf, <3>ih, <3>b DEF AgEffOp
        <4>2. DOMAIN [prev EXCEPT ![t[x].key] = t[x].value] = DOMAIN st
          OBVIOUS
        <4>3. \A k \in DOMAIN st :
                [prev EXCEPT ![t[x].key] = t[x].value][k]
                  = IF k = t[x].key THEN t[x].value ELSE prev[k]
          OBVIOUS
        <4>4. \A k \in DOMAIN st :

LEMMA AgBridgeUtil ==

(***************************************************************************)
(* A sufficient criterion for CC!SnapshotIsolation.                        *)
(***************************************************************************)
AgReadOK(tr, ss, oo) ==
  \/ ss[oo.key] = oo.value
  \/ \E iw \in DOMAIN tr :
       /\ tr[iw] = [op |-> "write", key |-> oo.key, value |-> oo.value]
       /\ \A i2 \in DOMAIN tr : tr[i2] = oo => iw < i2

AgSICond(D, SS, mm, n) ==
  /\ \A j \in 1..n : \E m \in Nat : D[j] = [i \in 1..m |-> D[j][i]]
  /\ \A j \in 1..n : WritesEachKeyAtMostOnce(D[j])
  /\ \A j \in 1..n : \A oo \in SeqToSet(D[j]) : oo.op \in {"read", "write"}
  /\ \A j \in 1..n : \A oo \in SeqToSet(D[j]) :
        oo.op = "read" => AgReadOK(D[j], SS[mm[j]], oo)
  /\ \A j \in 1..n : \A oo \in SeqToSet(D[j]) :
        (oo.op = "write" /\ oo.key \in DOMAIN SS[j-1]) => SS[mm[j]][oo.key] = SS[j-1][oo.key]

AgStOK(SS, IS, D, n) ==
  /\ SS = [k \in 0..n |-> SS[k]]
  /\ SS[0] = IS
  /\ \A j \in 1..n : SS[j] = CC!effects(SS[j-1], D[j])
  /\ \A p \in 0..n, q \in 0..n, r \in 0..n :
       (p <= q /\ q <= r /\ SS[p] = SS[r]) => SS[q] = SS[p]

LEMMA AgIdxMono ==
  ASSUME NEW n \in Nat, NEW SS, SS = [k \in 0..n |-> SS[k]],

            (p <= q /\ q <= r /\ SS[p] = SS[r]) => SS[q] = SS[p],
         NEW sts, sts = [i \in 1..n |-> SS[i-1]],
         NEW m1 \in 0..(n-1), NEW m2 \in 0..(n-1), m1 <= m2
  PROVE  Index(sts, SS[m1]) <= Index(sts, SS[m2])
  <1>cg. \A p \in 0..n, q \in 0..n, r \in 0..n :
            (p <= q /\ q <= r /\ SS[p] = SS[r]) => SS[q] = SS[p]
    OBVIOUS
  <1>len. Len(sts) = n
    <2>1. sts = [i \in 1..n |-> sts[i]]
      OBVIOUS
    <2> QED BY <2>1, AgFcnToSeq
  <1>char. \A mq \in 0..(n-1) :

                 PROVE  /\ Index(sts, SS[mq]) \in 1..n

      OBVIOUS
    <2>1. mq + 1 \in 1..n /\ sts[mq+1] = SS[mq]
      OBVIOUS
    <2>2. \E i \in 1..Len(sts) : sts[i] = SS[mq]

    <2>3. Index(sts, SS[mq]) \in 1..Len(sts) /\ sts[Index(sts, SS[mq])] = SS[mq]

    <2>4. Index(sts, SS[mq]) \in 1..n
      BY <2>3, <1>len
    <2>5. sts[Index(sts, SS[mq])] = SS[Index(sts, SS[mq]) - 1]
      BY <2>4
    <2> QED BY <2>3, <2>4, <2>5
  <1>a. Index(sts, SS[m1]) \in 1..n /\ SS[Index(sts, SS[m1]) - 1] = SS[m1]
    BY <1>char
  <1>b. Index(sts, SS[m2]) \in 1..n /\ SS[Index(sts, SS[m2]) - 1] = SS[m2]
    BY <1>char
  <1> SUFFICES ASSUME Index(sts, SS[m1]) > Index(sts, SS[m2]) PROVE FALSE
    BY <1>a, <1>b
  <1> DEFINE aa == Index(sts, SS[m1]) - 1
  <1> DEFINE bb == Index(sts, SS[m2]) - 1
  <1>ab. aa \in 0..n /\ bb \in 0..n /\ bb < aa /\ SS[aa] = SS[m1] /\ SS[bb] = SS[m2]
    BY <1>a, <1>b
  <1>mm. m1 \in 0..n /\ m2 \in 0..n /\ m1 <= m2
    OBVIOUS
  <1>eq. SS[m1] = SS[m2]
    <2>1. CASE bb <= m1
      <3>1. SS[m1] = SS[bb]
        BY <1>cg, <1>ab, <1>mm, <2>1
      <3> QED BY <3>1, <1>ab
    <2>2. CASE ~(bb <= m1)
      <3>1. m1 <= bb /\ bb <= aa /\ SS[m1] = SS[aa]
        BY <2>2, <1>ab
      <3>2. SS[bb] = SS[m1]
        BY <1>cg, <1>ab, <1>mm, <3>1
      <3> QED BY <3>2, <1>ab
    <2> QED BY <2>1, <2>2
  <1> QED BY <1>eq

LEMMA AgSICriterion ==
  ASSUME NEW IS, NEW T, IsFiniteSet(T), NEW n, n = Cardinality(T),
         NEW D, AgIsEnum(D, T),

  <1>E. PICK E : /\ E \in CC!executions(IS, T)

    BY <1>E DEF AgGenE
  <1>len. Len(E) = n /\ CC!Len(E) = n
    BY <1>Efn, <1>n, AgFcnToSeq, AgBridgeUtil
  <1>ps. \A k \in 1..n : E[k].parentState = SS[k-1]
    <2> DEFINE Q(k) == (k \in 1..n) => E[k].parentState = SS[k-1]

    <2>1. \A k \in Nat : Q(k) => Q(k+1)

      <3>1. CASE k = 0
        <4>1. E[1].parentState = IS

        <4> QED BY <4>1, <3>1 DEF AgStOK

        <4>2. E[k].parentState = SS[k-1]

        <4>3. E[k+1].parentState = CC!effects(E[k].parentState, E[k].transaction)

        <4>4. E[k].transaction = D[k]
          BY <4>1, <1>E
        <4>5. SS[k] = CC!effects(SS[k-1], D[k])

        <4> QED BY <4>2, <4>3, <4>4, <4>5
      <3> QED BY <3>1, <3>2
    <2> HIDE DEF Q
    <2>2. \A k \in Nat : Q(k)
      BY ONLY <2>0, <2>1, AgFS!NatInduction, AgT!IsaM("blast")
    <2> QED BY <2>2 DEF Q
  <1> DEFINE sts == [i \in 1..n |-> SS[i-1]]
  <1>sts. CC!executionStates(E) = sts
    <2>1. CC!executionStates(E) = [i \in 1..CC!Len(E) |-> E[i].parentState]

    <2> QED BY <2>1, <1>len, <1>ps
  <1>Se. CC!SeqToSet(CC!executionStates(E)) = {SS[i-1] : i \in 1..n}

  <1>par. \A j \in 1..n : CC!parentState(E, D[j]) = SS[j-1]
    <2> SUFFICES ASSUME NEW j \in 1..n PROVE CC!parentState(E, D[j]) = SS[j-1]

    <2>1. \A i \in 1..n : E[i].transaction = D[j] => i = j

    <2>2. E[j].transaction = D[j] /\ j \in 1..CC!Len(E)

    <2>3. (CHOOSE i \in 1..CC!Len(E) : E[i].transaction = D[j]) = j

    <2> QED BY <2>3, <1>ps DEF CC!parentState
  <1>bo. \A m1 \in 0..(n-1), m2 \in 0..(n-1) :

    <2> SUFFICES ASSUME NEW m1 \in 0..(n-1), NEW m2 \in 0..(n-1), m1 <= m2

      OBVIOUS
    <2>1. Index(sts, SS[m1]) <= Index(sts, SS[m2])
      BY <1>n, AgIdxMono DEF AgStOK
    <2> QED BY <2>1, <1>sts, AgBridgeUtil DEF CC!beforeOrEqualInExecution
  <1>ct. \A j \in 1..n : CC!CT_SI(D[j], E)
    <2> SUFFICES ASSUME NEW j \in 1..n PROVE CC!CT_SI(D[j], E)
      OBVIOUS
    <2>mj. mm[j] \in 0..(n-1) /\ mm[j] <= j-1
      BY <1>n
    <2>j1. j-1 \in 0..(n-1)
      BY <1>n
    <2>st. SS[mm[j]] \in CC!SeqToSet(CC!executionStates(E))
      <3>1. mm[j] + 1 \in 1..n /\ SS[(mm[j]+1)-1] = SS[mm[j]]
        BY <2>mj, <1>n
      <3> QED BY <3>1, <1>Se
    <2>sp. CC!parentState(E, D[j]) = SS[j-1]
      BY <1>par
    <2>bo1. CC!beforeOrEqualInExecution(E, SS[mm[j]], CC!parentState(E, D[j]))
      BY <1>bo, <2>mj, <2>j1, <2>sp
    <2> DEFINE RSE == {s \in CC!SeqToSet(CC!executionStates(E)) :
                          CC!beforeOrEqualInExecution(E, s, CC!parentState(E, D[j]))}
    <2>inRSE. SS[mm[j]] \in RSE
      BY <2>st, <2>bo1
    <2>m. PICK mlen \in Nat : D[j] = [i \in 1..mlen |-> D[j][i]]
      BY DEF AgSICond
    <2>mdom. DOMAIN D[j] = 1..mlen
      BY <2>m
    <2>dlen. Len(D[j]) = mlen /\ CC!Len(D[j]) = mlen
      BY <2>m, AgFcnToSeq, AgBridgeUtil
    <2>sts2. CC!SeqToSet(D[j]) = {D[j][z] : z \in 1..mlen}
      BY <2>mdom, AgBridgeUtil DEF SeqToSet
    <2>rs. ASSUME NEW oo \in CC!SeqToSet(D[j])
           PROVE  SS[mm[j]] \in CC!ReadStates(E, oo, D[j])
      <3>1. SS[mm[j]] \in CC!SeqToSet(CC!executionStates(E))
        BY <2>st
      <3>2. CC!beforeOrEqualInExecution(E, SS[mm[j]], CC!parentState(E, D[j]))
        BY <2>bo1
      <3>ooset. oo \in SeqToSet(D[j])
        BY AgBridgeUtil
      <3>3. \/ SS[mm[j]][oo.key] = oo.value
            \/ \E write \in CC!SeqToSet(D[j]) :
                  /\ write.op = "write" /\ write.key = oo.key /\ write.value = oo.value
                  /\ CC!earlierInTransaction(D[j], write, oo)

        <4>2. CASE oo.op = "read"

            <6>3. Index(D[j], wr) = iw
              <7>1. \A i \in 1..mlen : D[j][i] = wr => i = iw

                <8>1. D[j][i].op = "write" /\ D[j][iw].op = "write" /\ D[j][i].key = D[j][iw].key

                <8> QED BY <8>1, <2>mdom DEF AgSICond, WritesEachKeyAtMostOnce

              <7>1. \E i \in 1..Len(D[j]) : D[j][i] = oo

            <6>5. iw < Index(D[j], oo)

            <6>6. CC!earlierInTransaction(D[j], wr, oo)

            <6> QED BY <6>2, <6>6
          <5> QED BY <5>2, <5>3
        <4>3. oo.op \in {"read", "write"}
          BY <3>ooset DEF AgSICond
        <4> QED BY <4>1, <4>2, <4>3
      <3> QED BY <3>1, <3>2, <3>3 DEF CC!ReadStates
    <2>fin. IsFiniteSet({CC!ReadStates(E, oo, D[j]) : oo \in CC!SeqToSet(D[j])} \cup {RSE})

      <3>1a. IsFiniteSet({D[j][z] : z \in 1..mlen})
        BY <3>1, AgFS!FS_Image, AgBridgeFinite
      <3>2. IsFiniteSet(CC!SeqToSet(D[j]))
        BY <3>1a, <2>sts2
      <3>3. IsFiniteSet({CC!ReadStates(E, oo, D[j]) : oo \in CC!SeqToSet(D[j])})
        BY <3>2, AgFS!FS_Image, AgBridgeFinite
      <3> QED BY <3>3, AgFS!FS_AddElement, AgBridgeFinite
    <2>cmp. CC!Complete(E, D[j], SS[mm[j]])
      <3> DEFINE XX == {CC!ReadStates(E, oo, D[j]) : oo \in CC!SeqToSet(D[j])} \cup {RSE}
      <3>1. \A Y \in XX : SS[mm[j]] \in Y
        BY <2>rs, <2>inRSE
      <3>2. SS[mm[j]] \in UNION XX

      <3>3. SS[mm[j]] \in INTERSECTION(XX)

      <3>4. SS[mm[j]] \in CC!INTERSECTION(XX)

      <3>2. PICK oo \in CC!SeqToSet(D[j]) : oo.op = "write" /\ oo.key = kk

      <3>3. kk \in DOMAIN SS[j-1]
